 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Amardeep Singh Bhatia** was elected as the Chair of the Asian Productivity Organization (APO) for the 2025–26 term during its 67th Governing Body Meeting (GBM).
 
• The Asian Productivity Organization (APO) is an intergovernmental organization committed to enhancing productivity in the Asia-Pacific region.
 
• The APO's Governing Body Meeting (GBM) is the highest decision-making body of the organization, comprising representatives from member countries.
 
• India has been an active member of the APO and has contributed significantly to its initiatives, including hosting various workshops and training programs.
 
• The Chair's role is instrumental in steering the strategic direction and implementation of productivity-related programs across member nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Productivity Organization (APO):**

 
 
• Founded in 1961, the APO aims to promote socioeconomic development through productivity enhancement.
 
• It has 21 member economies, including India, Japan, South Korea, and Singapore.
 
• The APO's initiatives include research, training programs, and technical assistance to member countries.
 
 
 
• **India and APO:**
 
 
• India joined the APO in 1961 as a founding member.
 
• India regularly hosts APO events, including workshops and seminars, focusing on productivity improvement.
 
• The National Productivity Council (NPC) serves as India’s liaison office with the APO.
 
 
 
• **67th Governing Body Meeting (GBM):**
 
 
• The GBM is an annual event where representatives of member countries discuss and decide on APO policies and programs.
 
• The 67th GBM highlighted the importance of innovation, sustainability, and inclusive growth in productivity enhancement.
 
• Elections for APO leadership roles, including the Chair, are conducted during this meeting.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Chair in APO:**
 
 
• The Chair oversees the implementation of APO policies and ensures alignment with member countries' goals.
 
• It represents the APO globally and fosters collaboration among member economies.
 
• The Chair also plays a key role in driving initiatives related to emerging productivity trends such as green productivity and digital transformation.
